note: Rewritten from the species description in Scheffrahn & Carrijo 2020, originally in English; the alate is a dealated specimen in the original, hence labelled dealated alate; the text omits locality, type material, distribution, ecology and molecular analyses, and plate information is not recorded; measurements follow Table 1 (14 soldiers, 4 colonies) and Table 2 (3 alates, 2 colonies) of the original; the right forewing length and body length with wings columns of Table 2 are empty in the original and are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is unique in the genus in having a red-orange head capsule with the pronotum and the rest of the body dark brown: R. costaricensis and R. unicolor have a yellowish brown head capsule with a yellow pronotum, while the remaining species have either a black head with a yellow pronotum or both head and pronotum black. The alate head width of this species is also among the smallest, comparable to R. flavicinctus (1.2 mm) and R. magninotus (1.25 mm). All soldier measurements are smaller than in R. volcanensis; the soldier antennal ridges form a smaller oval platform on the gena, projecting at an acute angle from the frontal margin in oblique lateral view, whereas in R. volcanensis the platform is larger and only weakly rises above the frontal margin; the third antennal segment is proportionally narrower and more elongate.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
(Dealated alate) Head capsule red orange; pronotum, thorax, abdomen and wing scales uniformly dark brown. Compound eyes small, trapezoidal, the side below the ocellus straight, the side near the gena more curved. Ocelli oval, concolorous with the interior of the antennal sockets, about their own radius from the eye margin. Vertex and frons with about a dozen erect setae about 0.15 mm long; frons darker, with shallow rugae at the frontal ridges. Pronotum slightly wider than the head capsule, anterior margin slightly incised, anterolateral corners nearly right-angled, posterior margin narrowly concave, margins with a few long and many short setae, the surface pilosity as on the vertex. Relative lengths of the basal antennal segments 1>2=3<4. Wing scales with about 20 setae, of similar length and density to those of the head and pronotum. Femora pale orange brown, tibiae distinctly paler. Arolium present.
Measurements (mm, means in parentheses; n=3, 2 colonies): maximum head width (including compound eyes) 1.19—1.26 (1.23), maximum pronotum width 1.21—1.29 (1.24), maximum ocellus diameter 0.08—0.10 (0.09), maximum compound eye diameter 0.27—0.30 (0.28), body length 6.00—6.90 (6.33), antenna with at most 9 segments (broken).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule dark brown in dorsal view along the anteclypeal margin, the anterolateral ridges and the antennal ridges, grading to orange brown towards the frons, orange in the middle of the head capsule and yellow on the occiput; mandibles almost entirely black. In ventral view the postmentum pale orange brown, contrasting with the pale yellow head capsule. Head capsule narrow and elongate, rectangular, lateral margins parallel, with a few setae except on the occiput. Pronotum much wider than long, with a few long setae on the margins and in the middle. Frontal ridges and frons forming a shallow groove, at about 40° to the plane of the vertex. In dorsal view the antennal ridges form a small oval platform on the gena; in oblique lateral view the antennal ridges project at an acute angle from the lateral frontal margin. Antennal ridges and anterolateral ridges weakly rugose, the outer edge of each ridge at about 110°. Eye spots large, narrow and oblique, only slightly paler than the head capsule. Third antennal segment narrow at the base, longer than the second and fourth segments combined. Mandibles about half the length of the head capsule, apex curved through about 60°, the outer edge slightly curved in the middle of the blade, with a shallow swelling at the base.
Measurements (mm, means in parentheses; n=14, 4 colonies): head length to lateral mandible base 1.72—2.72 (2.33), maximum head width 1.16—1.56 (1.42), head height including hypopharynx 0.90—1.32 (1.18), pronotum length 0.64—1.05 (0.91), pronotum width 1.10—2.10 (1.56), antenna 12—13 segments (12.43), third antennal segment length 0.14—0.22 (0.18).
